comments.text:
Three Dog Night was one of my first favorite bands! "My song" is Never Been to Spain. 
I liked Neil Diamond when I was growing up. My fav is Brother Love's Traveling Salvation Show. 
Glenn Campbell was suddenly everywhere! Every variety show, and parodied by comedians of the day. (My pick: Witchita Lineman.)
Stones: Can't beat Can't You Hear Me Knocking. 
CCR was my mom's favorite band. I know all their songs. I'm a little sick of their stuff (lol). 
Ooh, I loved Blood, Sweat, and Tears, too. My pick - And When I Die. 
One of my biggest Beatles memory (aside from the cartoon) was my dad loving Lady Madonna when it came out. 
Honestly, I never really cared for CSN. Guinnevere is a pretty song. If I had to pick one, I'd go with Cathedral. That song spoke to me. 
The song Get Together (Youngbloods) will always remind me of a dreamy spring day. 

Hope everything and everyone is doing well. Glad to see you again. Whatever time you may need, though, please take it. Keeping you and yours in my prayers. 😊♥️
comments.author: @kelf114
